original_read_order: Complete original two-page submission first, then frozen claims and A check notes; independent primary reopening followed.

checks.title: Consultation ITKV draft, printed 1 September 2026 at 18:18
checks.read_extent: Physical pp. 1–2, 4–5 and 10–12 independently read; not all 12 pages claimed.
checks.result: Section C retains the either-EfA-minimum-or-legal-criteria disjunction; proposed section 1 prescribes eWA 10124. Page 12 makes future extension conditional on dissemination and savings. Pages 10–11 explicitly describe ongoing specialist-interface work and one-off supplier integration costs, not an unreasonable cost threshold.
checks.temporal_limit: Exact common draft is corroborated by matching quoted content; filename date is not the printed date. Forecast figures in the draft are not independently validated or attributed to DATABUND.

checks.title: d-NRW eWA service description, stand March 2026
checks.read_extent: Complete substantive short service entry, technical interfaces and implementation stages; current primary web page independently opened.
checks.result: Confirms OZG 10124, OSCI/DVDV infrastructure, software adaptation and phased integration. It is not a census of all administrative software or a record of excluded competing front ends.
checks.temporal_limit: Current page states March 2026 but exact September bytes are not authenticated; later page availability is qualified.

checks.title: Dataport eWA specialist-application integration documentation
checks.read_extent: Entire short substantive article, independently reopened and read in saved primary HTML as well as web extraction.
checks.result: XMeld for registration; XPassAusweis notifications to document authorities, including 9501/9502/9503 from 1 May 2025. Existing pilot backends are AKDB, HSH, Komm.ONE and regisafe; adaptation is required and costs depend on Land arrangements.
checks.temporal_limit: Undated current operator material supports mechanisms but cannot determine historical denials, national market share, causal investment losses or legal adequacy of every competitor.

checks.title: KoSIT XPassAusweis release history 25.11, final 31 January 2025
checks.read_extent: Physical pp. 1 and 5, exact PDF identity independently verified; seven-page document not fully read.
checks.result: Section 2.4.1.1 records EWA-PA notifications by online services to the respective document authority; dated basis corroborates the current operator standard description.
checks.temporal_limit: Release history is not the full standard or proof of market/interface access.

checks.title: BSI TR-03128 part 3, version 1.3, 26 March 2026
checks.read_extent: Cover, selected pp. 5–9, complete pp. 14–18 and 22–23 independently read; not a full 25-page reading.
checks.result: The central writing service receives eWA orders, authenticates document holders and writes/checks the new address. Sovereign certificates have assigned public functions. ZSD outsourcing with a sovereign certificate needs BSI agreement; third-party non-sovereign operation retains provider responsibility and security obligations.
checks.temporal_limit: Security architecture does not prove that named competitors were denied access, whether denial was unjustified, or whether multiple Länder complained. Backend integration is not competing-front-end access.

checks.title: Current OZG section 4, contextual comparison
checks.read_extent: Complete clause and official full-law amendment header independently checked.
checks.result: A specified component mandate and qualified Land deviation/open-interface rules do not alone resolve the alleged practical market effect.
checks.temporal_limit: Full-law header includes 6 October 2026 amendment after the 14 September response; not silently substituted as September legal proof.

checks.title: PAuswG section 7, functional competence
checks.result: Land-designated identity authorities perform identity-document matters; functional allocation does not prohibit the same municipal organisation holding registration duties.
checks.temporal_limit: Current single clause corroborated by pre-author BSI and PAuswV; no full historical amendment-chain or all Land designation survey.

checks.title: PAuswG section 20a, sovereign certificate roles
checks.result: Certificate content follows statutory competence; this is not proof of an actual private applicant denial or a ban on all contractors.
checks.temporal_limit: Current single clause with dated pre-author technical corroboration; no retrospective denial inference.

checks.title: PAuswV section 19, address changes
checks.read_extent: Complete clause independently read; full official law header independently opened, last amendment 30 January 2026.
checks.result: The identity authority changes the chip address and identity register, and uses a sovereign certificate; electronic registration initiates the linked procedure.
checks.temporal_limit: Supports legal roles, not separate physical buildings or a compulsory in-person visit.

checks.title: eIDKG section 6, competent authorities
checks.result: Land-designated eID-card authorities perform eID matters; one organisation may perform more than one legal function.
checks.temporal_limit: No complete state competence or historical amendment survey.

checks.title: eIDKG section 12, identification for address updates
checks.read_extent: Complete clause, especially paragraph 4, independently read.
checks.result: eID-card authorities may perform electronic identification following electronic registration to update the address and use sovereign certificates.
checks.temporal_limit: Not proof of a universal contractor exclusion or separate physical office.

checks.title: eIDKG section 14a, sovereign certificates
checks.result: Certificate scope follows assigned eID-card authority/manufacturer functions.
checks.temporal_limit: Does not identify any denied competing service or establish reasons for an actual denial.

checks.title: AufenthG section 71, foreigner-authority competence
checks.read_extent: Full paragraph 1 and relevant section context independently read; not all statutory tasks independently researched.
checks.result: Foreigner authorities perform residence/pass-law tasks, subject to statutory and Land designations.
checks.temporal_limit: No all-Land competence survey; related section 78(7) permits other designated bodies.

checks.title: AufenthG section 78, electronic residence documents
checks.read_extent: Complete relevant paragraphs 5 and 7 independently read; full official law header independently opened, last amendment 22 July 2026.
checks.result: Paragraph 5 substitutes foreigner authority for identity authority in relevant eID rules; paragraph 7 permits address changes by foreigner authorities and other Land-designated authorities.
checks.temporal_limit: Supports function-specific competence, not organisational exclusivity; all designated bodies are not surveyed.

checks.title: HSH primary company history and product description
checks.read_extent: Complete short company description independently opened.
checks.result: Company says founded 1991, currently approximately 3,000 MESO registration offices and existing online-service products. This provides a concrete longstanding supplier, not the asserted aggregate majority of all specialist applications or dated online-service history for plural members.
checks.temporal_limit: Current self-description is not an independent national market census; 1991 alone does not establish a strict greater-than-35-year threshold at 14 September 2026 or greater-than-20 years of online services.
